reason: Reflective insulation and clean fabric may make a protective cover for the growing room.
expectation: They will form a cover that helps retain warmth and light.

effect: The materials made a ventilated thermal screen intended to divide the crop space from the aisle.
reaction: The open edge for ventilation is a useful detail.
reason: The screen has an overlap for the service rail, suggesting that is where it belongs.
expectation: The screen will hang from the rail to reduce heat and light losses around the crops.

effect: The screen is installed, and the remaining goal is to protect the reservoir.
reaction: The ventilation route remaining open is reassuring.
reason: The reservoir is the new target, but its protection requirements are not yet clear.
expectation: The inspection will identify what can be used to protect it.

effect: Inspecting the reservoir automatically added a steel cover that limits evaporation while preserving aeration; the protection goal remains active.
reaction: The automatic combination was useful, and the clear aeration openings make sense.
reason: The covered reservoir may need insulation to retain warmth during the storm.
expectation: The insulation will help keep the circulating nutrient solution warm.

effect: The insulation completed the reservoir protection, while low-power circulation and stored heat helped keep the growing room safe. All chapter goals are complete.
reaction: The practical heat measures were satisfying, and Mara’s mention of rain provided a quiet contrast with the storm.

mostWorthwhile.text: Installing the thermal screen was worthwhile: it concentrated the dimmed light and warmth around the existing beds without blocking ventilation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the reservoir was less engaging as a decision because its sole compatible operation executed automatically, although the resulting cover had a clear purpose.

surprise.text: I was surprised that insulating the reservoir also led to low-power circulation and releasing heat from the earlier storage tank; Mara’s note about rain added an unexpected human detail.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The reservoir inspection was a hint-led step, but the steel cover’s evaporation control and aeration openings were explained.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the storm response connected earlier engineering to the crops’ survival, and I would want to see the station recover and the discovery’s return unfold.
